process.sectionTitle: Your TIE process, step by step
process.sectionLead: The government process is free, but confusing. VisaMesa keeps you on track and can automate the hardest parts.

checklist.title: Structured checklist
checklist.description: The official TIE process has six steps — empadronamiento, cita previa, forms, fees, and more — and it's easy to miss one. VisaMesa turns each step into a clear checklist with document lists and plain-language guidance, so you always know what to do next and what you've already finished.
checklist.videoLabel: App demo: progressing through TIE steps with animated checkmarks

calendar.title: Appointment monitoring
calendar.description: Empadronamiento and cita previa slots in Barcelona can vanish in minutes, especially in peak season. With our service, VisaMesa watches the official booking sites from your phone and books when a slot opens — so you're not stuck refreshing pages all day.
calendar.videoLabel: App demo: appointment monitoring finding available slots

form.title: Form pre-fill
form.description: Enter your passport, visa, and address once in your encrypted profile. VisaMesa uses those details to pre-fill the EX-17, Modelo 790, and government booking forms — you review, print, and sign knowing nothing was copied wrong.
form.videoLabel: App demo: form fields automatically filled from profile

payment.title: One-time service
payment.description: One payment on our website unlocks the full service — step-by-step guidance, form pre-fill, and appointment automation. No App Store subscription or hidden renewals: pay once, sign in with the same Google account in the app, and start your TIE journey.
